status: SPECIFICATION ONLY — not executed against real Luna/Supabase/browser
fixtures: Use approved disposable fixtures or authorised read-only existing records. Example names/numbers are replaceable; do not mutate owner records or auto-confirm proposals. Include duplicate names, hidden/foreign entities and real import pipeline.
repeatPolicy: At least five repeats for each ordinary exact/natural/two-turn conversation on stable data; preserve raw timings and task outcomes.

cases.request: Search a dense common word matching 100k rows

cases.request: Request natural or nested catalogue-row ranking

cases.request: Cancel a slow catalogue request and inspect server activity
